meta.x_name: equivalent slope angle (arctan of horizontal load over vertical load)

meta.comparability_note: Markers found automatically as connected components of the series fill colour (legend box excluded); centroid converted with gridline calibration; error bars (black) not transcribed. Slope is emulated on level sand by a horizontal load, theta = arctan(Fx/Fz) (slides 23 to 24, valid while no avalanche occurs), so slope effects on normal load, soil failure downslope and slip face avalanching are absent. Slip s = 1 minus v/vd. Slides only, not a peer reviewed paper; load per wheel for this series is not stated. Toyoura sand is a uniform laboratory quartz sand. The 0 deg marker of this series is hidden behind the other series and was not recovered.
